names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 18 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιοι Αγρίππας, Βικτωρίνος, Δωρόθεος και Θεόδουλος», with the rank word left off. The life of Agapitus, on the same site, spells the same man «Βικτώριος»; both forms are the source's and the day's line is the one taken here.
